evidence: covers state.Compartment.get.B3, state.Transaction.state.B7, state.cm6.059.d1 (crates/ferrum-state/tests/written_state.rs:33-64). B3 and B7 (docs/parity/ferrum-state/raw/behaviors.jsonl) state cm6's result: the compartment effect after appendConfig writes into the start state's map (mirrors/cm6/state/src/state.ts:97-112), so c.get(start) changes and a later transaction from start uses the new content; state.cm6.059.d1 (raw/decisions.jsonl) replaces that: the start state is never changed, the new state is cm6's. The test asserts the new state's facet ["B"] and its compartment content (same_extension with b), the start state's compartment (a) and its facet ["A"] unchanged, and a later appendConfig from start reading ["A"] and content a: B7's whole result as the decision amends it, on B3/B7's input (appendConfig then Compartment.reconfigure in one transaction). Record mismatch, low: state.cm6.059.d1's behaviors list names state.Compartment.reconfigure.B6 and state.Transaction.state.B7 but not state.Compartment.get.B3, whose cm6 result (c.get(startState) changes) this test asserts the opposite of; the decision's text ("a transaction never changes its start state") covers it. Passes (cargo test -p ferrum-state --features __test --test written_state, the 5 tests by name, 5 passed).

covers state.Compartment.reconfigure.B1 (crates/ferrum-state/tests/written_state.rs:352-366). B1: c.reconfigure(ext) is an effect of the internal type Compartment.reconfigure (@internal, mirrors/cm6/state/src/facet.ts:435-437) with value {compartment, extension}, ext not copied; the type has no map, so mapping returns the same effect (facet.ts:425-427, state.ts:446). The test maps the effect through an insertion, asserts Some, applies it: facet [2] and comp.get(next) is the given content (same_extension, not a copy). Everything public of B1 asserted. Passes (cargo test -p ferrum-state --features __test --test written_state, the 5 tests by name, 5 passed).

covers state.Facet.compute.B8 (crates/ferrum-state/tests/written_state.rs:466-487). B8 names 66 fixtures (F0053 ...) and test-facet#16, #21, #22, of which #22 does not discriminate the getter-not-called case (see its line). Severity low for the test; whether the fixtures carry the A, P, B order is for the hazards run (B8's hazards).
